sections.title: Unit 7: Costa Rica — Lesson 3
body: Welcome to lesson 3 of Unit 7 in the Latin American Regional Studies track: Costa Rica: Demilitarization, Biodiversity & Democratic Welfare.
In this lesson, we explore el estado benefactor: salud universal, educación y la ccss, examining the country's environmental, civic, and economic models.

items: Describe Costa Rica's universal social security model, preventive EBAIS health teams, and the Nicoya Blue Zone longevity phenomena.
Master the terminology and syntax of estado-bienestar-seguridad-social.
Deploy advanced socio-environmental vocabulary (el estado benefactor, la cobertura universal).
